propositions: Four call sites in dispatch_one.py and dispatch_apply_phases.py cast to optional capability protocols (SupportsComments, SupportsLinks) but perform no runtime check, only a static type assertion.

A transport lacking an optional capability member raises AttributeError at dispatch time, which is caught by a broad except Exception block, silencing the failure and reporting the mutation as successfully applied.
The capability Protocols exist to permit a second backend (DC) to legitimately omit optional capabilities, making the silent-skip defect newly consequential.

Runtime guards using isinstance() against @runtime_checkable Protocols, combined with explicit logging and bridge_alerts records (distinct kinds: outbound-comment-capability-absent, outbound-link-capability-absent), must replace the cast-only assertion.
The _call_with_retry function (71-145 LOC) must relocate from dispatch_one.py to dispatch_apply_phases.py to satisfy the 800-LOC module-size ceiling after adding guards.

A proxying transport that forwards via __getattr__ satisfies hasattr but fails isinstance on Python 3.12+, requiring a fallback member check (isinstance-primary with hasattr fallback) to remain consistent with fetcher.py and avoid false capability-absent alerts for decorator/wrapper transports.
